incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A dimly lit street at night lined with traditional brick buildings featuring white window frames and illuminated by street lamps.

observations.description: Traditional brick buildings with white frames and windows, some with flower boxes.
Street lamps mounted on walls, emitting bright light.
Flower boxes with red flowers visible on building facades.
Dark street with no visible vehicles or people.
